source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor names/descriptions/readings in SDR and Sensor lists plus Web match SPEC; numbering is 1, 2, 25.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 3/0 minutes; unique code.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES/ipmitool, but invents a title sensor, uses truncated OOB only and omits INTB population/Web completeness.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; requires INTB board/zone identity, complete population and full IB/OOB/Web evidence.

old_problem: `INTB` is not defined by the source, so neither its physical board or thermal-zone boundary nor whether `TEMP_INTB` is one record, a prefix or the full population can be inferred. The source also jumps from criteria 2 to 25, while DeepSeek invents the testcase title as a sensor name and truncates evidence. Historical review therefore requested an Engineering Decision.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict without expanding or guessing INTB. ED-03 permits the exact board/zone, namespace membership and sensor crosswalk to remain Project Configuration; ED-08 preserves Web visual evidence, ED-15 forbids invented thresholds and ED-19 preserves this row's identity. Complete inventories establish population before filtering, and criteria 1/2/25 are retained as written while missing numbers are treated only as an editorial defect.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2021, its same-row DeepSeek fields, GPT V2, historical record, ED-01 through ED-30 and standard ipmitool/OpenBMC read semantics were reviewed; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 2022 / Wistron-BMC-01042-V002 / 3435e3cee64f8bd5.
INTB remains an opaque Project-defined label: the review does not invent an acronym expansion, board name or thermal-zone meaning.
Completeness is proven from full untruncated IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists plus every Web row, using an approved per-member physical-location crosswalk; grep is only a secondary view.
A shared sensor reading across interfaces proves reporting parity, not temperature accuracy. Accuracy is out of scope unless Project SPEC supplies an independent reference and approved tolerance.
The source states criteria 1, 2 and 25. Their numbering gap is recorded but does not authorize fabrication of criteria 3 through 24.
No ipmitool, authentication, sensor read, Web login/capture, thermal/fan/airflow action, log clear, BMC, host or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Project-mapped INTB sensor-population and five-view reporting reconciliation
test_case.purpose: Verify every Project-defined INTB temperature member is bound to the correct physical board or thermal zone and reports SPEC-consistent identity, value, units, state, thresholds and freshness across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web.
required_package: Exact SUT/BMC/platform revision and approved opaque INTB board-or-zone definition
Versioned INTB/TEMP_INTB complete population and per-member physical-location plus five-view record crosswalk
Approved value/unit/state/threshold/range/freshness/unavailable rules and passive workload/airflow/environment sampling context
Approved ipmitool, trusted protected OOB/Web access, evidence hashes and retained logs
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; bind the opaque INTB namespace to the approved physical board/zone and enumerate every expected member. Preserve existing logs. Capture complete untruncated aligned IB and OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` outputs before applying the approved TEMP_INTB filter; capture every BMC Web Sensor row and pagination state. Compare population, location, identity, units/value/state/threshold/freshness against the versioned crosswalk and SPEC. Do not use the testcase title as a sensor name, assume grep completeness, truncate output, clear logs, change thresholds/fans/airflow or automatically retry.
test_case.expected_result: The approved INTB population is complete with no missing, extra or duplicate member; every member maps to the correct physical board/zone and has aligned SPEC-valid fields in all five views with complete Web evidence and no thermal anomaly.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the signed INTB definition, complete population/crosswalk, full raw IB/OOB inventories, complete Web evidence and all per-member fields within approved rules. FAIL on wrong or unknown location, missing/extra/duplicate member, stale/unavailable/out-of-range value, cross-view mismatch or thermal alarm. Missing mapping or authoritative limits is NOT READY, not a guessed PASS; the end user owns the verdict.
safety_gate: Passive read-only only; prohibit thermal stimulus, threshold writes, fan/airflow changes and log clearing.
Retain complete inventories before filtering and protect credentials; bind every record to the approved physical location.
Stop on ambiguous membership, missing/duplicate/stale data, cross-interface mismatch, out-of-range temperature or thermal alarm.
No automatic retry; preserve the first discrepancy, thermal context, Web evidence and logs.
expected_evidence: Versioned opaque INTB definition, complete TEMP_INTB population and physical/five-view crosswalk
Complete timestamped IB/OOB SDR and Sensor-list raw outputs, exits and hashes before filtering
Complete BMC Web screenshots/export including all pages and member locations
Per-member identity/unit/value/state/threshold/freshness and missing/extra/duplicate comparison with passive workload/airflow/environment context
Criteria-numbering-defect, no-write/no-clear/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong target, access problem, ambiguous mapping, missing/duplicate/stale member, interface mismatch, out-of-range value or thermal alarm, stop passive collection and preserve the first state. Close or revoke sessions and rotate any exposed credentials. Do not change thermal policy, clear logs or retry automatically; escalate the exact member and physical zone to BMC/thermal owners.

source_conflict.reason: The Project-owned opaque namespace and explicit complete-member/physical-zone crosswalk resolve INTB versus TEMP_INTB without guessing; the 1/2/25 gap remains an editorial defect rather than missing invented requirements.

blocked.reason: Purpose, passive method, evidence, safety and recovery are defined; exact namespace membership and limits are runtime Project Configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Opaque INTB board/zone definition, complete TEMP_INTB member set, per-member physical/five-view crosswalk, sensor limits/freshness and passive sampling context.
